sections.text:
[Intro]
{spoken dialogue over a muffled, low-pass filtered house-party beat}
{female voice, spoken, flirty} Hey. What are you doing tonight?
{male voice, spoken, flat deadpan} Hold my Celsius. I can't go on a date. I'm an AY-EYE founder.
{female voice, spoken, incredulous} ...You're a what?

[Drop]
{the filter opens and the beat drops hard, stadium gang-vocal chant, one note per syllable, crowd shouts back}
I'M AN AY-EYE FOUNDER! (FOUNDER!)
I'M AN AY-EYE FOUNDER! (FOUNDER!)

[Verse 1]
{male lead vocal, flat deadpan talk-sing, bored, very clear diction}
I don't take a salary, I take a token budget.
Burned a quarter-million, and my investors love it.
My co-founder's a Mac mini sitting on a shelf.
It never sleeps, it never eats. It's basically myself.
Closed my seed in a cold plunge, it was over in a flash.
He couldn't feel his fingers, but he wired me the cash.
Matcha's at a record high, there's a shortage in Japan.
My valuation's at a record high. I don't have a plan.

[Pre-Chorus]
{female lead vocal, sweet and sarcastic, sung, rising synth sweep, snare roll build}
So your co-founder's a computer,
and your money's made of air,
and you'd rather freeze a VC
than take me anywhere?

[Chorus]
{massive electroclash drop, male lead sings, gang vocals shout FOUNDER, a female voice answers mockingly}
I'M AN AY-EYE FOUNDER! (FOUNDER!)
I can't come out tonight.
{female voice, mocking, sing-song} Of course you can't.
{male lead} I'M AN AY-EYE FOUNDER! (FOUNDER!)
See you after tokens!
I'M AN AY-EYE FOUNDER! (FOUNDER!)
No dating till Series B.
{female voice, mocking, sing-song} Babe, you're pre-seed.
{male lead} I'M AN AY-EYE FOUNDER! (FOUNDER!)
See you after tokens!
positiveStyles: male and female call and response

sections.text:
[Interlude]
{beat drops to a lone kick drum, spoken dialogue}
{female voice, spoken, curious} So what does your company actually do?
{male voice, spoken, proud deadpan} We build agents. For agents.
{female voice, spoken} And what do those agents do?
{male voice, spoken, after a pause} ...They're on the waitlist.

[Verse 2]
{female lead vocal, sassy confident talk-rap, very clear diction, roasting him}
When he says "we're in stealth," it means there's nothing there.
When he says "autonomous agents," it's a cron job and a prayer.
When he says "a cracked team," that's his roommates and a Mac.
When he says "we're talking to Sequoia," they never wrote back.
Eighty grand on a film crew for a button on a page.
Every comment says "insane." Nobody clicked it, babe.
Zyn in his lip, a cap that just says "building," and a hoodie for a brand
that doesn't have a product, but the merch is in demand.

[Chorus]
{bigger drop, handclaps, male lead sings, gang vocals shout FOUNDER, a female voice answers mockingly}
I'M AN AY-EYE FOUNDER! (FOUNDER!)
I can't come out tonight.
{female voice, mocking, sing-song} Of course you can't.
{male lead} I'M AN AY-EYE FOUNDER! (FOUNDER!)
See you after tokens!
I'M AN AY-EYE FOUNDER! (FOUNDER!)
No dating till Series B.
{female voice, mocking, sing-song} Babe, you're pre-seed.
{male lead} I'M AN AY-EYE FOUNDER! (FOUNDER!)
See you after tokens!
positiveStyles: male and female call and response

sections.text:
[Bridge]
{half-time, sparse beat, rapid call and response: a female voice asks, a male voice answers flat and deadpan, rhythmic}
{female} Revenue? {male} I annualized a Tuesday.
{female} Users? {male} Waitlist.
{female} Product? {male} Next model.
{female} Co-founder? {male} Mac mini.
{female} Salary? {male} Tokens.
{female} Girlfriend? {male} Series B.
{female} Five years? {male} Post-AGI.
{female, exasperated} Oh my god.

[Final Chorus]
{biggest drop, key lift, stacked gang vocals shout FOUNDER, male lead sings, the female voice mocks along}
I'M AN AY-EYE FOUNDER! (FOUNDER!)
I can't come out tonight.
{female voice, mocking, sing-song} Of course you can't.
{male lead} I'M AN AY-EYE FOUNDER! (FOUNDER!)
See you after tokens!
I'M AN AY-EYE FOUNDER! (FOUNDER!)
No dating till Series B.

{male lead} I'M AN AY-EYE FOUNDER! (FOUNDER!)
See you after tokens!

sections.text:
[Outro]
{synths filter down, spoken dialogue}
{male voice, spoken, deadpan} Anyway. Gotta go. See you after tokens.
{female voice, spoken, amused} Cute. Hold my matcha. I'm an AY-EYE founder too. Series B.
{male voice, spoken, after a pause} ...So what are you doing tonight?
{female voice, spoken, flat} Board meeting.
{glitch stutter, abrupt stop}
